title: REQ-BCM-001 Enter extended session
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-001 (Enter extended session): The BCM shall enter the extended diagnostic session on request 10 03 from the default session and report P2 = 50 ms and P2* = 5000 ms.

title: REQ-BCM-002 Programming session entry rule
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-002 (Programming session entry rule): The BCM shall only enter the programming session from the extended session; a direct request from the default session shall be rejected with conditionsNotCorrect.

title: REQ-BCM-003 Return to default session
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-003 (Return to default session): The BCM shall return to the default session on request 10 01 from any session and lock all security levels.

title: REQ-BCM-004 Session timeout
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-004 (Session timeout): The BCM shall fall back to the default session if no diagnostic request or TesterPresent is received for 5 s while in the extended session.

title: REQ-BCM-005 TesterPresent
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-005 (TesterPresent): The BCM shall answer TesterPresent 3E 00 with 7E 00 and shall stay silent for 3E 80.

title: REQ-BCM-006 Hard reset
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-006 (Hard reset): The BCM shall perform a hard reset on 11 01, respond 51 01 and afterwards be in the default session.

title: REQ-BCM-007 Soft reset
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-007 (Soft reset): The BCM shall perform a soft reset on 11 03 and respond 51 03.

title: REQ-BCM-008 Read VIN
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-008 (Read VIN): The BCM shall provide the 17-character ASCII VIN via ReadDataByIdentifier DID 0xF190 in all sessions without security access.

title: REQ-BCM-009 Read spare part number
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-009 (Read spare part number): The BCM shall provide the 11-byte spare part number via DID 0xF187 in all sessions.

title: REQ-BCM-010 Read software version
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-010 (Read software version): The BCM shall provide the 4-byte ECU software version via DID 0xF189.

title: REQ-BCM-011 Read ECU serial number
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-011 (Read ECU serial number): The BCM shall provide the 10-byte ECU serial number via DID 0xF18C.

title: REQ-BCM-012 Read hardware version
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-012 (Read hardware version): The BCM shall provide the hardware version via DID 0xF191.

title: REQ-BCM-013 Read active session
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-013 (Read active session): The BCM shall report the active diagnostic session via DID 0xF186.

title: REQ-BCM-014 Read battery voltage
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-014 (Read battery voltage): The BCM shall report the battery voltage via DID 0x4A20 with 0.01 V resolution.

title: REQ-BCM-015 Read ambient temperature
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-015 (Read ambient temperature): The BCM shall report the ambient temperature via DID 0x4A21 with an offset of -40 degC.

title: REQ-BCM-016 Read door status
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-016 (Read door status): The BCM shall report the door open status bitfield via DID 0x4A22.

title: REQ-BCM-017 Read lamp outputs in extended session only
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-017 (Read lamp outputs in extended session only): The BCM shall report the lamp output state via DID 0x4A30 only in the extended session.

title: REQ-BCM-018 Read immobiliser status (protected)
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-018 (Read immobiliser status (protected)): The BCM shall report the immobiliser status via DID 0x4A61 only in the extended session with security level 1 unlocked.

title: REQ-BCM-019 Read odometer at last DTC
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-019 (Read odometer at last DTC): The BCM shall report the odometer value at the last DTC via DID 0x4A50 in km.

title: REQ-BCM-020 Read central lock state
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-020 (Read central lock state): The BCM shall report the central lock state via DID 0x4A31.

title: REQ-BCM-021 Write interior light timeout
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-021 (Write interior light timeout): The BCM shall allow writing the interior light timeout DID 0x4A10 (2 bytes, 5 to 300 s) only in the extended session with security level 1 unlocked.

title: REQ-BCM-022 Write auto-lock speed
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-022 (Write auto-lock speed): The BCM shall allow writing the auto-lock speed threshold DID 0x4A11 (5 to 50 km/h) in the extended session with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-023 Write welcome light enable
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-023 (Write welcome light enable): The BCM shall allow enabling or disabling the welcome light via DID 0x4A12 in the extended session without security access.

title: REQ-BCM-024 Write rear wiper interval
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-024 (Write rear wiper interval): The BCM shall allow writing the rear wiper interval DID 0x4A13 (2 to 20 s) in the extended session.

title: REQ-BCM-025 Write variant coding
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-025 (Write variant coding): The BCM shall accept 4-byte variant coding via DID 0x4A40 only in the extended session with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-026 Write market region
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-026 (Write market region): The BCM shall accept the market region DID 0x4A41 values 0 to 4 in the extended session with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-027 Write crash unlock enable
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-027 (Write crash unlock enable): The BCM shall allow configuring crash unlock via DID 0x4A51 (0 or 1) with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-028 VIN is read-only
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-028 (VIN is read-only): The BCM shall reject any attempt to write the VIN DID 0xF190.

title: REQ-BCM-029 Security level 1 unlock
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-029 (Security level 1 unlock): The BCM shall grant security level 1 in the extended session after a valid seed/key exchange 27 01 / 27 02.

title: REQ-BCM-030 Security key sequence
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-030 (Security key sequence): The BCM shall reject a SecurityAccess key that is not preceded by a seed request with requestSequenceError.

title: REQ-BCM-031 Security lockout
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-031 (Security lockout): The BCM shall block security level 1 after 3 invalid keys and refuse new seeds for 10 s.

title: REQ-BCM-032 Lamp self-test routine
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-032 (Lamp self-test routine): The BCM shall run the lamp self-test routine RID 0x5001 on start, support stop and report results, in the extended session.

title: REQ-BCM-033 Door lock actuator test
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-033 (Door lock actuator test): The BCM shall run the door lock actuator test RID 0x5002 only in the extended session with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-034 Reset learned key fobs
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-034 (Reset learned key fobs): The BCM shall reset the learned key fobs via RID 0x5003 start only, with security level 1.

title: REQ-BCM-035 Check programming preconditions
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-035 (Check programming preconditions): The BCM shall evaluate programming preconditions via RID 0x0203 in the programming session.

title: REQ-BCM-036 Read DTC count
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-036 (Read DTC count): The BCM shall report the number of DTCs matching a status mask via 19 01.

title: REQ-BCM-037 Read DTCs by status
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-037 (Read DTCs by status): The BCM shall report all DTCs matching a status mask via 19 02.

title: REQ-BCM-038 Clear all DTCs
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-038 (Clear all DTCs): The BCM shall clear all DTCs on 14 FF FF FF in the default and extended sessions.

title: REQ-BCM-039 Disable DTC setting
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-039 (Disable DTC setting): The BCM shall stop DTC status updates on 85 02 and resume on 85 01, only in the extended session.

title: REQ-BCM-040 Communication control
text: Requirement REQ-BCM-040 (Communication control): The BCM shall disable normal message transmission on 28 01 01 in the extended session.
